title: Mama · Genesis · 2007 Remaster
dek: PointCast and the reciprocal network are currently spinning Genesis.
body:
Currently spinning on PointCast and across the reciprocal network.

The shared track record lives at /now-playing.json, so PointCast, Industry Next, Allworthy, Passportz, Rally, and Common Hours / Stampz can carry the same title, artist, and Spotify door without copying private listening data or adding cross-site tracking.
author: mike
source: Mike chat directive, 2026-07-23: "add to a currently playing area on pointcast and across all the sites" followed by the Spotify track URL.

meta.distribution: PointCast dock, CH.SPN Block and feeds, and reciprocal Open Ad Network mounts
